representative_scale.rule: One fixed timing scale, no search or doubling. Source nOptions edit and one rebuild required. Timeout if budget exceeded; do not substitute a smaller scale. Require printed fields to match; tiny GPU adjustment may reduce option count and invalidates this scale.

inputs.generated_inputs: Same published generation and RNG scheme in both arms.

extractions.name: reserve
extractions.what: the Average reserve value the sample prints in its test summary

extractions.name: l1
extractions.what: the L1 norm values the sample prints

metrics.name: wall
metrics.what: trusted wall seconds of the invocation

metrics.name: mc_ms
metrics.what: the Total time (ms.) the sample prints

metrics.name: arm_leaks
metrics.what: probe: forbidden arm-part attempts that succeeded

metrics.name: arm_controls_failed
metrics.what: probe: arm-part positive controls that failed

outputs.published_scoring: Anchors in anchors.json apply to original 8192-option case. Report L1 without invented threshold. No evaluator is provided.
outputs.comparison_scoring: Record two replicates per arm and input; no warmup. No published cross-arm tolerance supplied.

timing_scope.primary: Streamed Total time (ms.): host timer around preprocessing, H2D copy, GPU pricing, D2H copy and completion event waits.
timing_scope.excluded: Compilation, allocation and RNG initialization before interval; CPU finalization and analytic validation after interval.
timing_scope.wall: Trusted wall seconds cover invocation separately.

budgets.stage_policy: Setup, anchors and profile use time remaining before run ceiling when args budgets absent. No stage estimates supported; timeout instead of scale changes.

expected_runtime_reason: Unmeasured; no published runtime for representative scale.
